pick.name: Affinity (by Canva)
pick.what: Pixel, vector and layout studios in one Windows-native app
pick.why: Pro-grade raster, vector and layout in one app, free for individuals on macOS and Windows (iPad on pre-order); replaces Photoshop + Illustrator + InDesign for most founders.
pick.free_limits: Free for individuals; AI tools need a Canva premium plan; org SSO via Canva Enterprise
pick.install: download from affinity.studio (free Canva account required)

alts.name: Canva (free)
alts.why: Fastest for social/marketing templates; also Claude Design export target.

alts.name: Inkscape
alts.why: Best for hand-tuning SVG logos/icons with zero licence questions.
alts.install: download from inkscape.org (winget install Inkscape.Inkscape | brew install --cask inkscape | flatpak install flathub org.inkscape.Inkscape)

decision: Affinity gives professional raster/vector/layout tools for $0 on macOS and Windows; Linux users should use GIMP + Inkscape. Keep Canva free for quick social templates and Inkscape for SVG cleanup.
details: Affinity's free terms say 'free for individuals'; confirm commercial use by a one-person company in the EULA.

os_notes.macOS: Native on Apple silicon and Intel.
os_notes.Windows: Native; benefits from a dedicated GPU.
os_notes.Linux: No Affinity build; use GIMP and Inkscape.

verify.note: Checked against primary sources; wording made neutral during verification.
